source_scope: Seven locally inspected product storyboard/candidate images and their documented design reasoning. Source thread reader failed; local artifacts supplied evidence. Source project acceptance and later revisions are not asserted.
test_method: Three independent text-only cross-product/state trials, one targeted edit of an originally generated pastel base, and one canvas-forwarding repeat of the speaker trial. All output pixels were inspected; an independent reviewer compared the visual mechanisms and refinements.
distribution: Client images, logos, private paths and full source research/prompt records are not distributed. Four newly generated unbranded test images are published; the initial speaker image remains local-only.
validation_boundary: Observed image appearance and mechanism transfer only. No client approval, physical particle measurement, animation continuity or universal provider acceptance claim.

cases.visual_review: Three square-section pastel sticks, lilac-white light, dry surface and a clear release origin transferred.
limitations: Visible purple grains include coarse fragments and the main surface is rougher than the requested fine-powder treatment.
Canvas was not included in the actual prompt; output is 3:2 instead of the specification 16:9.

cases.visual_review: Rigid dark shell, woven acoustic face, clear foreground hero and receding array transferred without powder, source packaging or branding.
limitations: Canvas was not included in the actual prompt; output is 3:2 instead of the specification 16:9.
The low gap above the ground does not make levitation as clear as the later wide trial.

cases.visual_review: Fine black fibers bend locally at a readable diagonal contact line and collect dry pigment; the pastel remains a rigid block with a visible edge.
limitations: Pigment still has localized coarse texture and accumulation.
A still proves the contact phase only, not brushing motion or continuous physical simulation.

cases.visual_review: Coarse airborne fragments were substantially reduced while three pastel sticks, source location, right-upward release, color and depth remained. A sparse translucent front is readable.
limitations: Some flakes or clumps remain near the root and the stick surface remains comparatively rough.
The requested approximate particle-size ceiling is not a measured physical guarantee.
This is a targeted edit of the capsule-generated base, not an independent text-only capsule run.

cases.visual_review: Three floating target speakers form a clear front-to-back hierarchy; black semi-matte shells and gray woven panels remain distinct in lilac-white light. No powder, source compact shape or branding was imported.
limitations: The black shell and rounded rectangular body are specified by the target, not a generic compulsory capsule shape.
A successful aspect-ratio example is not a guarantee of repeatability.
